hero.title: Estimate the impact of automating claim decisions
hero.summary: Enter your claims volume, your average handling time and how much of the work is eligible for automation. The estimator shows the handling time and cost True Aim could give back, on cautious assumptions, and the method and assumptions behind every figure.

cta.heading: Ready for a detailed assessment?
cta.description: The True Aim team can analyse your claims data, policy complexity and operational constraints and give you an estimate for your operation.

inputPanel.title: Your claims operation
inputPanel.subtitle: Adjust the values to match your situation
inputPanel.handlingTimeHint: Use an estimate for a typical claim without unusual complexity
inputPanel.automationLevel: Eligible for straight-through or assisted processing

capacity.title: Capacity unlocked
capacity.description: Fewer touches per claim, shorter handling time

metrics.fteNote: Reflects reduced handling effort, not headcount reduction

assumptions.currentHandlingCostFormula: = Handling time x Cost per minute x Claims volume
assumptions.capacityUnlockedFormula: = Current handling cost less the handling cost after automation, where an automated claim takes 36 seconds of review and each remaining manual claim takes half the current handling time
assumptions.reworkAvoidedFormula: = Rework claims x Handling time x Rework multiplier x Cost per minute
assumptions.assumption1: Savings apply only to eligible claim categories
assumptions.assumption3: Savings reflect reduced handling effort and rework
assumptions.assumption4: 75% sensitivity adjustment applied to all projections
assumptions.assumption5: Currency selection applies region-linked market data for insurance industry salary benchmarks, which informs the cost per minute
assumptions.note1: All figures shown represent gross operational impact and do not take into account the cost of True Aim's services.
assumptions.note2: Platform pricing is not provided. Final pricing is based on commercial terms to be discussed.
assumptions.note3: The estimator is based on data from real insurance claims and case studies with insurers.
